keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «외계인의 말을 아무도 알아듣지 못했다(문제)» 와 «말이 통하지 않을 때 음악과 그림이 대신 말해 준다(메시지)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (nobody could understand the aliens' sounds) and the message (music and pictures can speak when words cannot). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Nobody could understand the aliens, and their ship flashed red.
Dami played a song, and the kids drew pictures to talk with them.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: A silver spaceship landed on the school
, but nobody could understand the aliens'
. When their ship flashed red, Dami played a simple song on her
. The aliens hummed it back, and the kids drew pictures with
, and everyone became friends. Music and pictures can speak when words cannot.

words: a silver spaceship landed on the playground
a vehicle that travels in space
The teachers froze, and the principal hid.
the person in charge of a school
not usual or not known before
took out her recorder and played a simple song
a small musical instrument you blow into
The aliens drew their own planet with three moons.
a big round world in space, like Earth

qs.q: Why did someone shout, "They are getting angry!"?
qs.qko: 누군가가 왜 "They are getting angry!"라고 외쳤나요?
opts: The ship flashed red, and the ground started to shake.
The aliens took the principal away.
Dami played a very loud song.
evs: Then their ship began to flash red, and the ground started to shake.
Three tall, glowing aliens stepped out.
The aliens drew their own planet with three moons.
Before leaving, they gave the school a glowing stone that hums Dami's song.
why: 외계인들의 우주선이 빨갛게 번쩍이고 땅이 흔들리기 시작했어요. 그래서 누군가가 외계인이 화가 났다고 생각했어요. 교장 선생님은 숨었을 뿐, 외계인이 데려간 사람은 없어요.
The ship began to flash red, and the ground started to shake, so someone thought the aliens were angry. The principal only hid. The aliens did not take anyone.

qs.q: The text says the aliens "hummed the same song back." What does hummed mean?
qs.qko: 외계인들이 "hummed the same song back"이라고 나와요. hummed는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: made music with their mouths closed
evs: The teachers froze, and the principal hid.
But Dami, a quiet girl in Class 5, took out her recorder and played a simple song.
Their ship turned soft blue, and everyone cheered.
On the last day of the school year, a silver spaceship landed on the playground.
why: 다미가 리코더로 간단한 노래를 연주했고, 외계인들이 같은 노래를 돌려주었어요. 입을 다문 채 소리 내어 노래를 따라 불렀다는 뜻이에요.
Dami played a simple song, and the aliens gave the same song back. So hummed means they made the music with their mouths closed.

qs.q: How do we know the aliens became friendly?
qs.qko: 외계인들이 친구가 되었다는 것을 어떻게 알 수 있나요?
opts: Their ship turned soft blue, and they gave the school a gift.
They flew away without a word.
They took the kids' chalk drawings.
evs: Their ship turned soft blue, and everyone cheered.
Before leaving, they gave the school a glowing stone that hums Dami's song.
The aliens made strange sounds, but nobody could understand them.
why: 우주선이 부드러운 파란색으로 바뀌었고, 외계인들은 떠나기 전에 학교에 빛나는 돌을 선물했어요. 두 문장을 이으면 친구가 되었다는 것을 알 수 있어요.
Their ship turned soft blue, and before leaving, they gave the school a glowing stone. These two clues show they became friends.

ends: The aliens invite Dami's class to visit their planet with three moons.
외계인들이 다미네 반을 달이 세 개인 자기 행성에 초대해요.
Dami starts a music club to teach songs to everyone.
다미가 모두에게 노래를 가르치는 음악 동아리를 만들어요.

write.src: “Let’s <u>draw pictures</u> so that <u>they can understand us</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그 목적» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write something to do together and its purpose in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 할 수 있다» 를 쓰세요. (예: so that we can be friends)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what they can do. (e.g. so that we can be friends)

img.cover: On a sunny school playground beside a silver round spaceship, a quiet girl with a short black bob and round glasses in a pink cardigan plays a recorder while three tall glowing green aliens with long thin arms and big round black eyes sway and hum with their eyes half closed, and smiling kids draw a big sun, a round Earth, and a smiling face with colorful chalk on the ground.

scenes.1: On the school playground, a silver round spaceship flashes bright red lights and small stones bounce on the shaking ground, while three tall glowing green aliens with long thin arms and big round black eyes stand still, the teachers freeze in surprise, and a quiet girl with a short black bob and round glasses in a pink cardigan peeks out from behind a slide holding her recorder.
scenes.3: On the school playground, a silver round spaceship glows soft blue, and three tall glowing green aliens with long thin arms and big round black eyes hand a shining round stone to a quiet girl with a short black bob and round glasses in a pink cardigan next to a chalk drawing of a planet with three moons, while the kids and teachers cheer.

alt.1: The spaceship flashes red, and Dami hides behind a slide.
alt.3: The aliens give Dami a glowing stone.
alt.cover: Dami plays her recorder, and the aliens hum along.
